d: British comedian and actor Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison after being convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault involving four women between 2004 and 2009. During the sentencing hearing at Southwark Crown Court, Judge Joel Bennathan delivered pointed remarks about Brand's fame, conduct and treatment of the victims, calling him a 'sexual predator'. The judge's words have become a crucial part of this high-profile case, raising questions about power, celebrity and accountability. What did the judge's remarks reveal? Firstpost…
